sentences.text: Shri Anubhav Jain - Government Advocate for State
The appeal against conviction is admitted for final hearing.
Heard on I.A. No. 20552 of 2024 , which is second application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Ajitram Sahu.

This appeal is preferred against the judgment dated 13/05/2023 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Baihar District Balaghat in S.T. No. 392/2016 whereby the appellant has been convicted under Section 409 of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for life and fine of Rs.10,00,000/-, Section 420 and 120-B of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 7 years and fine of Rs.25,000/- and Section 6 of M.P.Protection of Interest of Depositors Act along with default stipulations.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is submitted that case of the present appellant is on the same footing as that of co-accused Mansingh Tekam & Lakhan Sahay Tekam @ Lakhan Say , I.A.No. 12854 of 2023 for appellant Nilesh Lilhare (CRA No.7071/2023), I.A.No.13435 of 2023 for appellant Punaram Sahu (CRA No.7226 of 2023) and I.A.No.13696 of 2023 for appellant Salikram Dhurve (CRA No.7511 of 2023) who have been enlarged on bail vide order dated 24/08/2023.
There are good chances of success of this appeal.
The final disposal of the appeal would take considerable time.

He,
therefore, prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Ajitram Sahu.
2 CRA-13221-2023 Learned Government Advocate opposes the prayer for grant of bail to the present appellant.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record as also maintaining principle of parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 20552 of 2024 is allowed.
